notes.title: Update Version 1.2.0 ( 05 / 31 / 2025 )
notes.content:
■ New Features
・Added a high-difficulty dungeon.  
　You can challenge this dungeon using the total number of Bonus Stars you've collected so far.

・Added new boss enemies.  
　・Each boss is protected by a barrier.  
　・Destroying a special device located on the same floor will disable the barrier.

・Added multiple powerful ally characters.  
　These allies come with the following unique traits:  
　・Only one of each exists.  
　・They can join your party when you defeat nearby bosses.  
　・Once recruited, they will follow you in other game modes as well.  
　・If defeated, they will leave your party, but can be found and recruited again in other locations.  
　・Their strengthened states will carry over into your next gameplay session.
 [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45312177/940130bed759e734195dac8d7745d57e17bdccdc.png[/img]
・Added Blue Stars.  
　・You earn points for each floor you clear. Once the gauge is full, you'll receive one Blue Star.  
　・Blue Stars can be used before starting a run to enhance your party or magic.

・Added blue mushrooms (small / large).  
　・Eating blue mushrooms restores the energy needed to cast destruction magic.  
　　・Small: 20%  
　　・Large: 100%

・Added blue mushrooms to the “Speed Clear Challenge” mode.

■ Gameplay & UX Improvements
・Allies can now join you in dungeons if you raise their level to 5 or higher when assigning stars at the start.  
・When too many bullets are on screen, bullets fired by allies will become more transparent to improve visibility.  
・Party members' HP gauges will now appear aligned toward the left edge of the screen.

■ Balance Adjustments
・Changed the level-up effect for the Dual Driller tribe.  
　The previous effect, “increased simultaneous shots,” has been replaced with “enhanced wall-breaking power.”  
　This change was made to reduce rendering and processing load.

■ Other
・Fixed minor bugs and issues.

Thank you for playing *Dungeon Raze*. We hope you enjoy this update!

notes.title: Update Version 1.1.0 ( 03 / 09 / 2025 )
notes.content:
[h2]New Features[/h2]
[list]
[*] Added Time Attack Mode.
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45312177/76b3a1fcac45db9e5342ad8e6d0adc9fda547698.png[/img]
[h2]Gameplay & Control Improvements[/h2]
[list]
[*] To prevent accidental game exits, the ESC key function has been changed from "Exit Game" to "Pause Menu".
[*] Added Volume Balance Settings.
[*] The continue confirmation phase has been removed, and Auto-Continue has been implemented.
[*] Changed Mini-map and Dungeon Destruction Rate to be always displayed.
[/list]
[h2]Balance Adjustments[/h2]
[list]
[*] In Endless Dungeon, an unintended infinite farming exploit was possible.
[*] To address this, Barrier Crystal drops from Giant Guard Robot LV3 have been removed.
We apologize for this nerf.
[*] Slightly increased the size of Destruction Magic.
[*] Reduced the cooldown of Destruction Magic and added Auto-Charge.
[/list]
[h2]Other Fixes[/h2]
[list]
[*] Fixed minor bugs and issues.
[/list]

Thank you for your continued support of DUNGEON RAZE!

notes.title: Update Version 1.0.4 ( 01 / 24 / 2025 )
notes.content:
■ New Features
-Destruction Magic Added
  Defeating enemies now builds up magic power, allowing you to unleash powerful spells.

■ Balance Adjustments
-Increased rewards from boss characters.
-Reduced difficulty in sealed dungeons.
-Increased the spawn rate of return portals.

■ Gameplay and UX Improvements
-Enhanced the visibility of the player character.
-Guard Slimes now occasionally reflect enemy attacks.

■ Graphics and Effects
-Improved visual effects for return portals.
-Updated graphics for certain map tiles.
-Added new map variations.
 
Thank you for your continued support of Dungeon Raze!

notes.title: Update Version 1.0.3 ( 01 / 12 / 2025 )
notes.content:
■ New Features
・Implemented the Return Portal, which doubles your score when used.

■ Bug Fixes
・Fixed an issue with mouse cursor display.
・Added a "Quit Game" button to the title screen.
・Fixed a soft lock issue caused by ESC key actions.
・Fixed a bug where stars on the result screen appeared smaller than intended.

■ Gameplay and UX Improvements
[strike]・Added a feature that forces the mouse cursor to move when buttons are displayed.[/strike]
・Removed the feature that forced the mouse cursor to move when buttons are displayed.
・Increased the display priority of enemy projectiles.
・Reduced the volume and bitrate of certain sound effects.

■ Balance Adjustments
・Increased the maximum clear rank cap from 50 to 70.
・Increased the amount of gold earned from defeating large monsters.
・Removed Lucky☆Moth from infinite dungeons. We apologize for this adjustment.
・As compensation, increased its spawn rate in sealed dungeons.
・Adjusted the result time display to add 1 second in cases where rounding made it appear 1 second shorter.
・Made walls slightly easier to break overall.

■ Other
・Established a new leaderboard to reflect the above balance adjustments.
・Implemented simple anti-cheat measures.


Thank you for your continued support of Dungeon Raze!

notes.title: Guidelines for Streaming and Video Content
notes.content:
Thank you for playing DUNGEON RAZE!
We welcome players to freely stream and upload gameplay videos of this game on platforms such as YouTube and Twitch, in accordance with the following guidelines:

[b]Permission for Streaming and Video Posting[/b]
[list]
[*] You are free to stream or upload gameplay videos, whether for commercial or non-commercial purposes.
[*] We would appreciate it if you could include a link to the game’s Steam store page in your video description (optional).
[/list]

[b]Prohibited Activities[/b]
[list]
[*] Please refrain from using this game for purposes unrelated to gameplay, such as defamatory remarks or promoting illegal activities.
[/list]

[b]Monetization[/b]
[list]
[*] Monetization on platforms such as YouTube and Twitch is allowed. Feel free to enjoy and share your experience with your audience.
[/list]

[b]Important Notes[/b]
[list]
[*] All copyrights and trademarks of the game are owned by the developers, but we encourage you to share your gaming experiences through streaming and video creation.
[*] These guidelines may be updated in the future. Any changes will be announced on the Steam store page or our official X account.
[url=https://x.com/uue_yoshida]https://x.com/uue_yoshida[/url]
[/list]

Thank you for your continued support of DUNGEON RAZE!
